summary: Brookfield Oaktree Holdings, LLC (BOH) filed an 8-K on April 27, 2026, disclosing a distribution in kind to Brookfield Oaktree Holdings Canada Inc. (BOHCI), an affiliate and sole holder of its Class A common units. Under the Distribution Agreement dated April 20, 2026, BOH transferred 100 Common Shares of OCG NTR Holdings LLC (NTR) valued at $317,356,320, representing 100% of its equity in NTR. The distribution was completed on April 20, 2026, with NTR indirectly holding interests in Brookfield Real Estate Income Trust Inc. The agreement was attached as Exhibit 10.1. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock was cited. This spin-off effectively separates the NTR assets from BOH without a public offering. Watch for any subsequent structural changes in Brookfield’s real estate portfolio.
